policy: package major follows Angular major; support active Angular plus immediately preceding supported/LTS major

lines.notes: Resolve exact aged security-patched compatible published framework/Material/CDK peers at implementation/release time; research head is not this baseline.
Maintenance line; use its own lockfile/toolchain and raise minimums for security patches as needed.

retirement: Target active + immediately preceding supported/LTS Angular major. At transitions reconcile published support end dates with actual upstream dates; do not silently withdraw an already advertised support commitment early. Any temporary overlap or extension must be explicit.
older_major_policy: Do not initially support Angular 20 or older without demonstrated consumer demand and explicit maintainer commitment.
consumer_engine_policy: Use each line's tested Angular-compatible Node range; never copy the private workspace's exact Node engine into a published manifest.

smoke_tests.purpose: Clean packed consumer plus schematic/CLI smoke.
Clean packed consumer smoke at advertised Node floor; historical/old-Node environment is isolated and has no publication credentials.

smoke_note: Resolve patched releases and actual lower bounds at implementation; Node 22.12.0 is an additional 21.x edge case. Install pnpm12 under Node24 before switching if the npm-based installer cannot run on the smoke Node. Do not run repository build tooling under every consumer Node.
release_baseline_policy: Exact aged security-patched published peers verified per branch; research source references never select dependencies. See research/version-observations.json and docs/07-upstream-security-release.md.
